abstract: Increasing parity is associated with a reduction in the risk of ovarian cancer, but it is not clear whether this association applies to different histopathological types and to borderline tumours. Moreover, the temporal relations are poorly understood, and the possible role of age at first birth remains unequivocal. We have investigated these issues in a case-control study nested in a nationwide cohort of women born between 1925 and 1960 in Sweden. During follow-up until 1984, 3486 invasive ovarian cancers (2992 epithelial, 330 stromal, 149 germ-cell, 15 not classifiable) and 510 tumours of borderline malignant potential were diagnosed. 5 individually age-matched controls (total 19,980) were selected for each case woman. After simultaneous adjustment for parity and age at first birth, increasing parity was associated with a pronounced consistent decrease in relative risk of all invasive cancers (odds ratio for each additional birth 0.81 [95% Cl 0.77-0.85]), epithelial cancer (0.81 [0.77-0.86]), stromal cancer (0.84 [0.72-0.98]), and germ-cell cancer (0.71 [0.48-1.05]), but a less consistent decrease for borderline tumours (0.92 [0.81-1.04]). The risk of ovarian cancer decreased by about 10% for each 5-year increment in age at first childbirth (odds ratios 0.89 [0.84-0.94] epithelial cancer, 0.92 [0.77-1.10] stromal cancer, 0.92 [0.65-1.32] germ-cell cancer, 0.93 [0.80-1.09] borderline tumours). Because our findings cannot be readily explained by theories involving incessant ovulation or high serum concentrations of gonadotropins, new aetiological hypotheses are needed. Pregnancy-dependent clearance from the ovaries of cells that have undergone malignant transformation could explain the reproductive risk factors for ovarian cancer.
abstract_ja: 経産回数の増加は卵巣癌のリスク低下と関連するが、この関連が組織型や境界悪性腫瘍にも当てはまるかは明らかでない。さらに、時間的関係はよく分かっておらず、初産年齢の役割も確定していない。本研究では、スウェーデンで1925年から1960年に生まれた女性の全国コホート内で行われた症例対照研究によりこれらの点を検討した。1984年までの追跡期間中に、浸潤性卵巣癌3486例（上皮性2992例、間質性330例、胚細胞腫瘍149例、分類不能15例）と、境界悪性腫瘍510例が診断された。各症例について、個別に年齢をマッチさせた対照を5例ずつ選択した（計19,980例）。経産回数と初産年齢を同時に調整した後、経産回数が1回増えるごとに、浸潤性癌全体（オッズ比0.81 [95% CI 0.77-0.85]）、上皮性癌（0.81 [0.77-0.86]）、間質性癌（0.84 [0.72-0.98]）、胚細胞腫瘍（0.71 [0.48-1.05]）のリスクは一貫して明確に低下したが、境界悪性腫瘍では一貫性の低い低下にとどまった（0.92 [0.81-1.04]）。初産年齢が5歳高くなるごとに、卵巣癌のリスクは約10%低下した（オッズ比は上皮性癌0.89 [0.84-0.94]、間質性癌0.92 [0.77-1.10]、胚細胞腫瘍0.92 [0.65-1.32]、境界悪性腫瘍0.93 [0.80-1.09]）。これらの知見は排卵の持続や高ゴナドトロピン血症の理論では説明しにくいため、新たな病因仮説が必要である。妊娠に依存して、悪性転化を起こした細胞が卵巣から除去される機序が、卵巣癌の生殖関連リスク因子を説明しうる。
